name: Invictarx
sum: Invictarx is a nodosaurid from the lower Campanian Menefee Formation of New Mexico, known from three partial skeletons.
holotype: WSC 16505, with rib fragments and osteoderms — upper Allison Member, Menefee Formation, New Mexico.
material: Two further skeletons (UMNH VP 28350 with dorsal vertebrae and others).
biology: Known mainly from armour and postcranial bones; no behavioural data in the sources used.
author: McDonald and Wolfe 2018
